svg.title: Modelled job-access gains from the Lelylijn
svg.desc: Modelled additional reachable jobs within 90 minutes, using the corrected CBS-derived study polygons and original baseline/scenario values for all 5,111 neighbourhoods. No gain is muted green. Positive gain bins have lower thresholds 1, 1,000, 5,000, 20,000, 50,000 and 100,000 jobs. Missing results are grey. The copper line is the modelled service scenario, with actual modelled station locations. Geography is not invented or altered for composition. Sources: lelylijn-neighbourhoods.geojson, lelylijn-context.geojson, lelylijn-route.geojson and lelylijn-stations.geojson. Display coordinates rounded to 0.1 SVG pixel. The figure concerns access to existing jobs, not job creation.
